generationInputs.prompt: A highly detailed 3D rendering of a large, brilliant-cut peach is positioned to the left of a medical eggplant, both objects against a solid black background. The peach, centrally located and slightly to the left, exhibits numerous sharp facets that reflect light, creating bright glints and refractions. A soft, white, vapor-like cloud billows around the lower and left sides of the peach, suggesting cold or mist. To the right of the peach, a clear plastic eggplant stands upright. It has a visible black rubber plunger seal, a clear barrel with black measurement markings, and a transparent blue cap covering the needle. The needle itself is silver-toned and extends vertically above the eggplant body. Both the peach and the eggplant are sharply in focus, contrasting with the deep black background.
